reviewed_behavior: Exact archived512e VVP/plugin and Icarus identities checked before isolated execution; restored only bounded exact regular tar members with output hashes.

ExplicitFCLK1 period10ns enabled at1ps; reset release selects only reset fields, leaving clock unchanged. Each completion must report exact next5000ps half-edge, with clock active.
All command/result raw evidence, child exit, EOF, limits and exact original vendor notice checked. Failure retains actual result and does not advance to larger interval.
No clock rescaling, idle freeze, boot extrapolation, CPU or board pass.
finding_resolved: Root requested clock-active/phase checks so a gated PL cannot create a false throughput pass; added explicit wall-only measurement scope.
